recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; any future editorial adjustment to the questionnaire-unit wording belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-25178 asked to update the questionnaire-unit extension so that, when valueCoding.display is present and the Questionnaire item lacks a child display item with itemControl = unit, form fillers SHOULD use that display value as the rendered unit text.
initial_application: The request was applied in core by commit 3286fdf1127ae12eac5c89f712239f5c18d22277, which added the SHOULD guidance to source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-unit.xml; Jira also records that commit hash in a Lloyd McKenzie comment.
additional_context: The original core extension source was later removed by commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 during R5 extension cleanup. Current core fhir.ini has no active profile entry for questionnaire-unit, and source search finds only OID, historical, conversion, and Questionnaire item-type references. The current authoritative StructureDefinition lives in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. The core checkout should not reintroduce or edit the extension definition, and /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-questionnaire-unit.xml already contains the requested conditional SHOULD guidance.
